fact: The Fact System is the project facility for registering, retrieving and tracing facts used in Taskbook decisions.
A Fact is an atomic statement with an identifiable source and scope.
The workspace .fact directory holds established project facts.
source: Maintainer decision: recoverable task-scoped fact view

fact: Keep confirmed knowledge that informs a future decision; keep guesses and temporary progress with the task.
A Taskbook Fact is a statement supplied by the taskbook or its fact attachment.
A Draft Fact is a statement proposed by a designer or implementer and awaiting review.
Each subagent receives the established facts relevant to its assignment so that assumptions from other conversations do not become inputs to its decision.
source: Maintainer decision: isolated subagent memory and atomic facts
